visualCharacteristics.purpose: slim bar under an article or news title: the title on the left and round social share buttons (LinkedIn, Facebook, X) on the right

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = title heading (optional; omitted rows render only the share buttons); optional row 2 = which networks to show, as links or a comma list (linkedin, facebook, x, email). Without row 2 it shows LinkedIn, Facebook and X. Share URLs are built from the current page URL, not the authored links

usage: Insight articles and media/news releases, directly under the hero.
reuseGuidance: Use wherever a page needs social share buttons. red-light is a colour hook for news pages (styled in the design pass). Icon glyphs (.share-bar-icon-<network>) are added in the design pass.
